latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Subtitle Generator.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for automatic subtitle generation.
- Supports subtitle creation in multiple languages (e.g., English and Spanish).
- Fast, cloud-based rendering with 1080p MP4 downloads in about 30–90 seconds.
- 100 free credits upon first anonymous sign-in, usable for 7 days.
- Streamlined workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and tracking job status.
- Designed for YouTubers and content creators needing quick, accurate captions.
